documents.title: Natural Earth 1:50m admin-0 polygons — Poland and Ukraine
documents.publicationCitation: Natural Earth vector, ne_50m_admin_0_countries.geojson, pinned source commit ca96624a; vendored as public/data/territory/cultural/countries_50m.geojson.
documents.notes: Used only as a spatial realization of the post-1951 Poland–USSR frontier in the two exchanged sectors. The UNTS treaty establishes the legal exchange and effective date. Applying Poland as a difference mask and Ukraine as a union mask leaves the rest of the already verified USSR-1945 exterior unchanged.
